title_zh: iPhone Duo 新增人脸解锁
content_zh:
爱范儿实测，苹果在今天推送的 iOS 27 开发者预览版为 iPhone Duo 新增了两项功能：合盖时可以用外屏摄像头刷脸解锁，从展开状态合上手机则可以直接锁屏。

刷脸解锁默认关闭，用户需要手动开启、录入人脸，并先用 Touch ID 或密码解锁一次。

当前测试版中，设备 45 分钟未使用后，需要再次验证指纹或密码。Apple Pay、查看密码和需要生物识别的 App 仍需 Touch ID 或密码。

外屏摄像头在识别时不会主动补光。在室内氛围灯或路灯下可以识别，完全黑暗时则很难解锁。
title_en: iOS 27 Preview Adds Cover Screen Face Unlock to iPhone Duo
content_en:
Apple’s latest iOS 27 developer preview introduces two notable features for the iPhone Duo: cover screen Face Unlock when folded and automatic screen locking upon closing the device.

Face Unlock is disabled by default and requires initial setup via Touch ID or passcode. For security, the system reverts to requiring fingerprint or passcode verification after 45 minutes of inactivity. Sensitive functions like Apple Pay and app authentication still strictly rely on Touch ID or a passcode.

Early testing shows the cover camera relies entirely on ambient light for recognition. While it performs well under standard indoor or street lighting, it struggles in total darkness due to the lack of dedicated fill light.

title_zh: Sam Altman：没有黄仁勋，AI 行业仍能继续发展
content_zh:
据 TechCrunch 报道，11 月 16 日，OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 在 Semafor 举办的「Silicon Valley & The World」活动上首次公开谈及黄仁勋辞去英伟达 CEO 一事。

他认为，尽管黄仁勋对 AI 行业的发展至关重要，但即使没有他的领导，AI 行业仍能继续发展。

Altman 表示，目前 AI 市场需求旺盛，相关收入和需求都在快速增长，因此他相信整个行业不会受到太大影响。

不过，他也强调，黄仁勋凭借非凡的雄心推动了行业发展，很难想象没有黄仁勋及其创办的英伟达，AI 革命会是什么样子。

谈及黄仁勋是否应该重返英伟达，Altman 则表示，自己对事件了解不够，无法作出判断。

他还称黄仁勋一直是自己心目中的英雄，但「英雄也有缺点」，并提起自己在 2023 年遭 OpenAI 董事会罢免、随后重新出任 CEO 的经历，对黄仁勋目前的处境表示同情。

与此同时，据 CNBC 和 CBS News 援引知情人士消息，英伟达董事会目前并未考虑让黄仁勋重返公司。

董事会仍将重点放在针对黄仁勋的调查上，即使已有超过 18 万人联署支持其回归，董事会也无意让他重新担任 CEO 或其他职务。
title_en: Sam Altman Weighs In on Jensen Huang's Nvidia Departure, Says AI Industry Will Keep Growing
content_en:
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman addressed Jensen Huang’s departure from Nvidia during Semafor’s "Silicon Valley & The World" event on November 16. While acknowledging Huang's pivotal role in driving the AI revolution, Altman expressed confidence that the broader AI industry will continue to thrive due to surging demand and revenue.

Referring to Huang as a personal hero, Altman drew parallels to his own temporary removal from OpenAI in 2023, remarking that "heroes have flaws." However, he declined to speculate on whether Huang should return, citing a lack of insider context.

Meanwhile, reports from CNBC and CBS News indicate that Nvidia’s board is currently not considering bringing Huang back. Despite a petition signed by over 180,000 supporters, the board remains focused on an ongoing internal investigation and has no intention of reinstating him.

title_zh: 华为 Mate X8 定档 11 月 24 日发布
content_zh:
华为公布 Mate X8 及全场景新品发布会时间，活动将于 11 月 24 日 14:30 举行。届时，华为将带来新一代大折叠屏手机 Mate X8。

华为在这次预热中展示了 Mate X8 背面的圆形相机模组和编织纹理。发布会海报以紫色机身为主，先展示了手机展开前的背部设计。
title_en: Huawei Sets November 24 Launch Event for Foldable Flagship Mate X8
content_en:
Huawei has officially announced its upcoming launch event scheduled for November 24 at 14:30 (GMT+8). The highlight of the showcase will be the company’s next-generation foldable smartphone, the Mate X8, alongside a new lineup of ecosystem products.

Official teasers reveal key design details of the Mate X8, including a prominent circular camera module, a distinctive woven texture on the rear panel, and a hero purple colorway.

title_zh: 算力吃紧，DeepSeek 限制 App 和网页端对话
content_zh:
昨天，DeepSeek 对 App/网页版的长对话进行了限额使用。

多名用户在 DeepSeek 的 App 或网页端收到提示，因算力不足，超过 7 天未使用的长对话无法继续。用户还反馈，单次输入的文字上限缩至约 4 万字。
title_en: DeepSeek Restricts Chat Features Amid Computing Power Shortage
content_en:
AI startup DeepSeek has imposed new usage limits on its app and web platforms, citing a shortage of computing resources.

Under the new restrictions, long conversations inactive for over seven days can no longer be resumed. Additionally, users report that the maximum input limit per prompt has been reduced to approximately 40,000 characters.

title_zh: 腾讯公开司庆讲话，要求核心业务团队面向 AI 再创业
content_zh:
11 月 16 日，腾讯文化公开了腾讯 28 周年 LinkTime 的现场笔记。腾讯管理层在会上说，核心业务眼下看起来稳固，AI 的进展已经足以改变原有业务的做法，各团队都需要重新考虑怎样用 AI 提高效率和创造力。

管理层提出，现有业务要继续升级，同时抽调人手探索新的业务，组织也要更扁平，让更小的团队有机会承担完整项目。笔记还提出，要用 AI 重新设计已有的管理流程和做事方式，让能交付成果的同事得到更多机会。

谈到算力投入时，管理层认为，AI 基建仍在早期，错过投入时机可能失去参与机会。腾讯将同时考量长期回报和投入产出比，希望投入既能催生 AI 原生业务，也能让现有业务获得新的增长。

腾讯管理层还用「金字塔」描述公司的 AI 布局。模型迭代负责降低智能成本，应用端有不同分工，小微面向个人助理，元宝侧重资讯和决策，WorkBuddy 负责执行工作任务。管理层把眼下的应用阶段比作早期用电照明，认为企业接下来要探索的是如何把智能工具用进各行业的生产环节。
title_en: Tencent Calls on Core Teams to Reinvent Businesses Around AI
content_en:
During Tencent's 28th-anniversary event, management urged core business teams to leverage AI to drive efficiency and innovation, framing the initiative as a new entrepreneurial push. The company plans to flatten its organizational structure to allow smaller teams to lead end-to-end projects while using AI to redesign management workflows.

Addressing infrastructure, management highlighted that AI compute investments remain in their early stages and warned that missing this window could result in lost market opportunities. Tencent aims to balance long-term returns with investment efficiency, fostering both AI-native applications and legacy business growth.

Tencent also outlined its strategic 'pyramid' AI framework, where model iterations reduce intelligence costs while specialized applications target specific use cases—such as Xiaowei for personal assistance, Yuanbao for information and decision-making, and WorkBuddy for task execution. Management compared the current AI landscape to the early adoption of electric lighting, noting that the key next step is integrating AI into industry-specific production workflows.

title_zh: 东南亚第三季度手机出货量下滑 36%，头部厂商中只有苹果增长
content_zh:
研究机构 Omdia 11 月 16 日发布报告称，今年第三季度东南亚智能手机出货量为 1650 万部，同比下降 36%。Omdia 将出货下滑与内存供应吃紧、元件成本上升联系起来。三星仍居第一，出货 370 万部，同比下降 20%。苹果在马来西亚和越南表现较强，出货同比增长 4%，是前五厂商中唯一增长的一家。

越南是该季度东南亚唯一录得出货增长的市场。小米在越南的出货量同比增长 50%，首次成为当地出货量第一的品牌。同期，印度尼西亚、菲律宾、马来西亚和泰国的整体出货量分别同比下滑超过 30%。
title_en: Southeast Asia Smartphone Shipments Drop 36% in Q3 as Apple Bucks Trend
content_en:
Smartphone shipments in Southeast Asia fell 36% year-over-year to 16.5 million units in the third quarter, according to research firm Omdia. The decline was largely attributed to tight memory supply and rising component costs.

Market leader Samsung retained its top position with 3.7 million units despite a 20% drop. Apple was the only top-five vendor to post growth, with shipments rising 4% year-over-year, bolstered by strong demand in Malaysia and Vietnam.

Vietnam was the region's only market to log overall shipment growth during the quarter. Xiaomi saw its shipments in Vietnam jump 50% year-over-year, claiming the top spot in the country for the first time. Conversely, shipments in Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia, and Thailand each plummeted by more than 30%.

title_zh: 百度第三季度营收降 1%，AI 云基础设施收入增长 94%
content_zh:
百度 11 月 16 日披露 2026 年第三季度业绩。集团营收为 308 亿元，同比下滑 1%，连续第六个季度同比下降。归母净利润为 13.95 亿元，上年同期为亏损。按非 GAAP 口径，摊薄后每股美国存托股份收益为 6.78 元。

百度一般性业务收入同比恢复增长。分项看，在线营销服务收入同比下滑 22%，AI 云基础设施收入则同比增长 94%。按百度内部管理口径，核心 AI 业务收入本季占百度一般性业务收入的 53%。其中，公司将公有云算力需求上升列为 GPU 云收入增长的原因。
title_en: Baidu Q3 Revenue Drops 1% as AI Cloud Infrastructure Surges 94%
content_en:
Baidu reported a 1% year-over-year revenue decline in the third quarter to 30.8 billion yuan, marking its sixth consecutive quarter of top-line contraction. Despite the revenue dip, the Chinese tech giant turned a profit, recording a net income attributable to shareholders of 1.395 billion yuan, compared to a loss in the prior-year period. Non-GAAP diluted earnings per ADS reached 6.78 yuan.

The company's performance highlights a significant shift in its business mix. Online marketing revenue fell 22% year-over-year, while AI cloud infrastructure revenue jumped 94%, fueled by growing public cloud compute demand and GPU cloud services. Core AI operations accounted for 53% of Baidu's general business revenue during the quarter.

title_zh: 小鹏汽车第三季度营收增长 19.1%，预计四季度交付至少 16.9 万辆
content_zh:
小鹏汽车公布 2026 年第三季度业绩。期内交付 118390 辆，营收为 242.8 亿元，同比增长 19.1%。归属于普通股股东的净亏损为 8.7 亿元，较上年同期扩大，较第二季度收窄。

第三季度，小鹏的汽车销售毛利率为 13.1%，环比上升 1 个百分点。公司将汽车销售收入增长归因于交付量增加，以及车型组合变化带来的平均售价提高。

小鹏预计，第四季度交付量在 16.9 万至 17.4 万辆之间，营收为 304 亿元至 318 亿元。
title_en: XPeng Posts 19.1% Q3 Revenue Growth, Eyes Record Deliveries in Q4
content_en:
XPeng announced a 19.1% year-over-year revenue increase to 24.28 billion yuan for the third quarter, driven by 118,390 vehicle deliveries. Net loss attributable to ordinary shareholders stood at 870 million yuan, widening from the previous year but narrowing sequentially from the second quarter.

The electric vehicle maker's vehicle gross margin rose to 13.1%, up 1 percentage point quarter-over-quarter. XPeng attributed the margin improvement to higher delivery volumes and a favorable product mix that lifted average selling prices.

Looking ahead, XPeng projects fourth-quarter deliveries to range between 169,000 and 174,000 units, with expected revenue of 30.4 billion to 31.8 billion yuan.

title_zh: 晶泰孵化的无界进化完成超 1 亿元 Pre-A 轮融资
content_zh:
据参与本轮投资的星连资本 11 月 16 日披露，无界进化已完成超 1 亿元 Pre-A 轮融资。星连资本、Prosperity7、华盖资本、华控基金和德同资本等联合投资，顺为资本、红杉中国和松禾资本追加投资。

无界进化由晶泰科技孵化。这是该公司继今年 6 月完成天使轮融资后，半年内完成的第二轮融资。据 36 氪报道，公司将把新资金用于基础模型研发和扩大自动化实验设施，服务于药物研发。
title_en: XTalPi-Incubated Boundless Evolution Raises Over 100M Yuan in Pre-A Round
content_en:
Boundless Evolution, an AI drug discovery startup incubated by XTalPi, has secured over 100 million yuan in a Pre-A funding round, co-investor Starlink Capital revealed on November 16. The round attracted joint investments from Starlink Capital, Prosperity7, Huagai Capital, Huakong Fund, and Detong Capital, with additional backing from existing investors Shunwei Capital, Sequoia China, and Green Pine Capital.

This marks the company's second successful financing round in six months, following an angel round in June. Boundless Evolution plans to use the new funds to advance foundation model R&D and expand its automated laboratory infrastructure to accelerate drug discovery efforts.

title_zh: 💡 博世中国区总裁：内存涨价，明年部分汽车成本最高增加 2.5 万元
content_zh:
第一财经 11 月 16 日报道，内存、电路板和电容等零部件涨价，正在推高车企成本，终端却仍要靠促销争取销量。一位头部车企副总经理算了一笔账：如果每辆车成本增加 5000 元，一家年销 30 万辆的车企，全年就要多支出 15 亿元。

博世智能驾控中国区总裁吴永桥在 11 月 5 日的乌镇汽车夜话上表示，内存涨价给博世集团带来了不小的成本压力。谈到自己负责的中国区业务，他说「我晚上都睡不着觉」。

按博世的测算，仅算内存、电路板和电容三项涨价，明年仅配基础 L2 辅助驾驶的燃油车，单车成本预计增加 2000 至 3000 元。辅助驾驶和座舱都采用高规格配置时，增量可达 2 万至 2.5 万元。

吴永桥建议，短期按实际功能需求配置算力，少用冗余硬件。他举例，一段式端到端辅助驾驶模型用 200 TOPS 就可以取得不错的效果。长期则可把辅助驾驶、座舱、车载通信和蓝牙集成在一块电路板上，共用内存。
title_en: Bosch Exec Warns Rising Component Costs Could Add Up to 25,000 RMB Per Vehicle Next Year
content_en:
Surging prices for core components—including memory chips, circuit boards, and capacitors—are placing heavy financial pressure on automakers already locked in aggressive market promotions.

Wu Yongqiao, President of Bosch Intelligent Driving and Control China, warned that these price hikes will significantly boost vehicle production costs next year. According to Bosch's estimates, basic L2-equipped gasoline vehicles will see per-unit costs rise by 2,000 to 3,000 RMB. For high-end models featuring advanced autonomous driving and smart cockpits, the cost increase could reach 20,000 to 25,000 RMB.

To mitigate these pressures, Wu suggested that carmakers configure computing power based on immediate functional needs rather than deploying redundant hardware in the short term. For long-term efficiency, he recommended integrating autonomous driving, cockpit systems, connectivity, and Bluetooth onto a single circuit board to share memory resources.

title_zh: 《GTA 6》预购超预期，Take-Two CEO 称会继续更新《GTA Online》
content_zh:
《GTA 6》定于 11 月 19 日发售。Take-Two 首席执行官施特劳斯·泽尔尼克在 IGN 11 月 9 日刊出的专访中表示，他对发售很乐观，并确认现有的《GTA Online》会继续获得新内容和活动。Take-Two 在同期财报电话会上称，《GTA 6》预购量远超公司初始预期。

泽尔尼克说，《GTA Online》的玩家群体多年来仍在增长。谈到 Rockstar 的下一步，他预计包括《GTA》在内的旗舰作品未来十年的内容形式和开发节奏都会变化。他点出的方向包括尝试用新的方式和渠道接触玩家，以及在发售后持续运营。
title_en: GTA 6 Pre-Orders Exceed Expectations as Take-Two Commits to Ongoing GTA Online Support
content_en:
Take-Two Interactive has reported that pre-orders for the highly anticipated *Grand Theft Auto VI* have far exceeded the company's initial expectations.

In a recent interview, CEO Strauss Zelnick expressed strong optimism about the upcoming launch while confirming that the existing *GTA Online* platform will continue to receive new content and live events, noting that its player base has sustained steady growth over the years.

Looking ahead, Zelnick outlined a long-term strategy for Take-Two's flagship franchises. Over the next decade, the company plans to evolve its content formats and development cadence, focusing on live-service operations and exploring innovative channels to engage players post-launch.

title_zh: 豆包工作上线「工作台」，把投研、设计等工具放进专用空间
content_zh:
豆包工作 11 月 16 日在电脑端上线「工作台」，首批覆盖金融、医疗、教育、创意设计等 21 个专业场景。每个工作台预先放入对应任务常用的技能和工具。

例如，金融投研工作台把公告解读、业绩分析、市场简报和公司研究做成单独的入口，可以按需连接万得、同花顺等数据服务。创意设计工作台则提供海报、社媒配图和品牌视觉等常用任务。

用户也可以按自己的工作需求配置工作台，保存后分享给别人。
title_en: Doubao Work Launches Dedicated Workbenches for Finance, Design, and Specialized Workflows
content_en:
Doubao Work has introduced a new desktop feature called "Workbench," offering tailored digital workspaces across 21 professional fields, including finance, healthcare, education, and creative design.

Each workbench integrates task-specific AI tools and skills. For instance, the financial research workspace features dedicated tools for analyzing earnings reports, interpreting corporate announcements, and connecting with major data services like Wind and Flush. Meanwhile, the creative design workspace offers tools for social graphics, posters, and brand visuals.

Users can also build custom workbenches tailored to their unique workflows and easily share their configured workspaces with team members.

title_zh: 苹果在美国启动健康 AI 研究，计划招募最多 20 万人
content_zh:
苹果与医疗 AI 公司 OpenEvidence 在美国启动 Apple Health AI Usage Study。参与者通过单独的研究 App 提交睡眠、心脏健康等问题，查看答案和附带的临床资料链接。研究团队将分析参与者怎样理解这些回答、在什么情况下信任它们，以及它们是否能帮助参与者为就诊做准备。

项目最多招募 20 万名参与者，限美国年满 21 岁、持有支持 Apple 智能的 iPhone 并运行 iOS 26 或更新版本的用户。苹果表示，研究收集的数据不会用于训练 AI 模型。
title_en: Apple Launches Health AI Study in US, Targeting Up to 200,000 Participants
content_en:
Apple has partnered with medical AI firm OpenEvidence to launch the **Apple Health AI Usage Study** in the United States. Through a dedicated research app, participants can submit questions regarding topics such as sleep and heart health, receiving AI-generated answers alongside links to clinical sources. The study aims to evaluate how users interpret and trust these responses, as well as whether the information helps them better prepare for medical consultations.

The initiative plans to recruit up to 200,000 participants. Eligibility is limited to US residents aged 21 or older who own an Apple Intelligence-compatible iPhone running iOS 26 or later. Apple explicitly stated that data collected during the study will not be used to train AI models.

title_zh: 国产独立游戏《艾希：续》众筹收官，筹得约 4281 万元
content_zh:
国产横版动作游戏《艾希：续》的 Steam 版众筹于 11 月 15 日深夜结束。摩点项目页显示，最初设定的筹款目标为 1 万元，最终共有 259743 人参与支持，筹得约 4281 万元。

续作沿用初代的横版动作玩法和动态旁白。玩家可以沿着旁白的指示行动，也可以偏离路线，引出不同的叙事。Steam 商店页列出的计划发行窗口是 2027 年第二季度，摩点数字版回报档的预计发放时间为同年 5 月。
title_en: Chinese Indie Action Game 'ICEY 2' Concludes Crowdfunding Campaign with ¥42.8 Million Raised
content_en:
The crowdfunding campaign for the Steam version of *ICEY 2*, a Chinese indie side-scrolling action game, officially concluded on November 15. According to the Modian platform, the campaign smashed its initial 10,000 yuan goal by drawing 259,743 backers and raising approximately 42.81 million yuan.

The sequel continues the side-scrolling combat and dynamic meta-narration of the original title, allowing players to either follow the narrator's instructions or branch off to unlock alternative storylines. According to its Steam store page, *ICEY 2* is scheduled for release in the second quarter of 2027, with digital backer rewards expected to be distributed in May 2027.

title_zh: 宝马首款国产新世代 iX3 在沈阳投产，本月开启交付
content_zh:
宝马首款国产新世代车型 BMW iX3 长轴距版已在沈阳生产基地投产，计划本月陆续交付。宝马为新车调整了车身和动力电池的生产工艺，大圆柱电芯直接集成进电池包，电池包也成为车身结构的一部分。

在沈阳铁西工厂里达厂区，新车从试制到量产经历了近千辆试制车验证。宝马披露，量产下线的车辆逐台进行道路测试，电池工厂、车身车间和总装车间也已打通质量数据。
title_en: BMW Starts Production of Domestically Made Next-Gen iX3 in Shenyang
content_en:
BMW has officially commenced production of the long-wheelbase BMW iX3—its first domestically produced "Neue Klasse" (Next Generation) vehicle—at its manufacturing hub in Shenyang, China. Deliveries are scheduled to begin later this month. The new model features updated manufacturing processes for both the chassis and power battery, integrating large cylindrical cells directly into the pack to serve as a structural component of the vehicle.

Produced at the Lydia plant in Shenyang's Tiexi District, the model underwent validation with nearly 1,000 trial units before reaching mass production. BMW revealed that every production vehicle undergoes individual road testing, with digital quality tracking fully integrated across the battery plant, body shop, and final assembly lines.

title_zh: 小马智行和丰田合作的无人驾驶出租车在广州接单
content_zh:
小马智行 11 月 16 日宣布，与丰田联合开发的铂智 4X Robotaxi 在广州开始示范运营，率先在南沙提供 L4 级自动驾驶出行服务。乘客可通过小马智行 App 或小程序呼叫。

新车以丰田纯电平台为基础，使用小马智行第七代自动驾驶系统。双方从车型定义阶段共同设计安全冗余和座舱交互。今年 2 月，量产车型已从广汽丰田第五生产线下线，随后进入公开道路测试。
title_en: Pony.ai and Toyota Launch Co-Developed Robotaxi Service in Guangzhou
content_en:
Autonomous driving startup Pony.ai announced on November 16 that the BoZhi 4X Robotaxi, jointly developed with Toyota, has officially launched demonstration operations in Guangzhou's Nansha District. Passengers can book Level 4 autonomous rides through the Pony.ai app or mini-program.

Built on Toyota's dedicated electric vehicle platform, the Robotaxi integrates Pony.ai's seventh-generation autonomous driving system. Both companies collaborated from the vehicle design stage to incorporate safety redundancies and optimized cabin interactions. Mass production began in February at GAC Toyota's fifth production plant, followed by extensive public road testing.

title_zh: 网易《哈利波特：魔法觉醒》将于明年 3 月关服
content_zh:
《哈利波特：魔法觉醒》工作室 11 月 16 日发布公告，因授权协议即将到期，网易运营的这款游戏将于 2027 年 3 月 3 日关闭服务器。

2026 年 12 月 21 日，游戏将停止充值和新用户注册，并从各平台下架。该作于 2021 年在中国市场上线，以霍格沃茨为背景，将校园探索和魔咒卡牌对战放进同一款游戏。
title_en: NetEase to Sunset 'Harry Potter: Magic Awakened' Following License Expiration
content_en:
The development team behind *Harry Potter: Magic Awakened* announced on November 16 that the NetEase-operated game will permanently shut down its servers on March 3, 2027, following the expiration of its licensing agreement.

In-app purchases and new user registrations will cease on December 21, 2026, when the title will also be removed from all app stores. First launched in China in 2021, the game combined immersive Hogwarts exploration with card-battling mechanics.

title_zh: 火山引擎全面开放 Seedance 2.5 的 4K 视频生成 API
content_zh:
火山引擎 11 月 16 日宣布，Seedance 2.5 的 4K 视频生成 API 已在火山方舟全面开放。个人和企业用户都可以调用，4K 输出采用 10bit 位深和 H.265 编码。

创作者可以先生成 480p 样片验证镜头和分镜，再用同一份样片生成 4K 成片。火山方舟文档显示，个人和企业账号的 4K 生成任务均为单任务并发，每分钟最多可发起 15 次请求。
title_en: Volcengine Launches 4K Video Generation API for Seedance 2.5
content_en:
Volcengine announced on November 16 the full availability of the 4K video generation API for its Seedance 2.5 model on the Volcengine Ark platform. Accessible to both individual and enterprise developers, the service outputs 4K video featuring 10-bit color depth and H.265 encoding.

Creators can streamline their workflow by generating 480p preview drafts to refine camera angles and storyboards before rendering the final 4K version using the same draft. Platform documentation indicates that 4K generation tasks run on a single-concurrency limit, capped at 15 requests per minute.
